web_blocks.html: Zydus Lifesciences (NSE: ZYDUSLIFE) earns a HOLD_WITH_HARD_STOP on our Zerodha starter (115 shares, ₹1,189.07 avg cost, 3.24% NAV). New capital stays ACCUMULATE_ON_DIP (TIER_2, 5%–6% NAV staged; COMPOUNDER_PASS, PASS_WITH_WATCH) at live CMP ₹1,236.00 (Nov 23 close: ₹1,199.50) [1][26]. On Nov 25, 2026, Zydus received USFDA EIRs for SEZ II Ahmedabad and Ankleshwar API Unit-2 [29]. That news lifted shares +3.04% into 4H overbought territory (RSI 70.38) just two days before the Nov 27 Saroglitazar PBC PDUFA [17][26]. At 27.3x P/E, Zydus trails Sun Pharma (41.6x) and Cipla (40.0x) [20][21]. Still, Pass 1 flagged 4 Form 483s at UK LiqMeds, ₹7,543 crore goodwill, and tough PBC rivals in Livdelzi and Iqirvo [30][33][34]. We ratchet our GTT stop up from ₹1,101.52 to ₹1,114.44. We will add Tranche 2 only post-PDUFA inside ₹1,167.24–₹1,215.29 or above ₹1,266.60.

book_subsections.title: Why Hold the Starter, Ratchet the Stop, and Wait Two Days
paragraphs: Welcome to the refreshed institutional dossier on Zydus Lifesciences Limited. Since our mid-November underwriting, two major shifts have occurred. First, our Zerodha portfolio initiated a starter position of one hundred fifteen shares at an average cost of eleven hundred eighty-nine rupees and seven paise—roughly three point two four percent of portfolio net worth. Second, on November 25, 2026, Zydus received positive USFDA Establishment Inspection Reports for SEZ II Ahmedabad and Ankleshwar API Unit-2, lifting the stock three percent to twelve hundred thirty-six rupees just forty-eight hours before the binary November 27 FDA decision on saroglitazar.

Our refreshed verdict balances conviction with discipline: Hold the one hundred fifteen shares, immediately ratchet the Zerodha GTT closing stop-loss upward from eleven hundred one rupees and fifty-two paise to eleven hundred fourteen rupees and forty-four paise, and keep new capital at Accumulate on Dip. Why not chase twelve hundred thirty-six rupees today? Because four-hour RSI sits overbought at seventy point four, the binary PDUFA is two days away, and our blind-spot audit flagged three fresh watchpoints: four November Form 483 observations at UK subsidiary LiqMeds, entrenched US PBC incumbents in Gilead's Livdelzi and Ipsen's Iqirvo, and seventy-five hundred forty-three crore rupees of consolidated goodwill.

book_subsections.title: What Changed in This Refresh
paragraphs: Chapters One through Six were audited completely blind to today's stock price and patched directly for new regulatory, competitive, and footnote evidence. Chapters Seven through Nine then integrate live November 23 to 25 market data, updated peer valuations against Sun Pharma, Cipla, Dr. Reddy's, and Lupin, the tightened six point two eight percent Bollinger volatility squeeze, and our upward-only stop-loss ratchet.

book_subsections.title: The Four Pillars of the Refreshed Zydus Underwriting
paragraphs: Keep four durable pillars in view as you read this refreshed monograph. First, Zydus is no longer a single-product US generic trade: India branded formulations, consumer wellness, international markets—now reinforced by Sri Lanka and Australia—and European orthopedic MedTech anchor a diversified global healthcare franchise. Second, fiscal 2027's twenty-four percent margin trough is a guided investment bridge to launch saroglitazar alongside ZYCUBO, not a structural collapse. Third, our blind-spot audit ensures we price the friction honestly—tracking three-site cGMP remediation at LiqMeds UK, Moraiya, and Baddi, seventy-five hundred forty-three crore rupees of goodwill, and tough US PBC incumbents in Livdelzi and Iqirvo. Fourth, holding our one hundred fifteen-share starter with an upward-ratcheted eleven hundred fourteen rupee stop keeps risk strictly bounded ahead of November 27.

book_subsections.title: Summary of the Risk-Reward Equation
paragraphs: At twenty-seven point three times Screener earnings, Zydus trades nearly thirty percent below Sun Pharma, Cipla, and Dr. Reddy's while growing trailing revenue twenty-four percent. Inside our eleven hundred sixty-seven to twelve hundred fifteen rupee support zone, our fourteen hundred twenty rupee base target delivers two point zero three to one reward-to-risk against the ratcheted eleven hundred fourteen rupee stop. Keep fifty-five percent of incremental rupee capital in cash around November 27, deploy twenty percent into Stage 2 shortlist leader Coforge, and pair twenty-five percent into Stage 2 pharma peer Dr. Reddy's—while letting post-PDUFA price action guide Tranche Two in Zydus.
